authority: User requested continuing mechanism discovery instead of waiting until tomorrow on 2026-09-09.
scope: Discovery cadence only; frozen economic rules, experiment budgets and confirmation unchanged.
trigger: After required maintenance, when no ready/running exploration takes priority and a distinct unsearched question is available.
accounting: Carry all daily-v1, supplemental-v1 and continuous batches exactly once. Use measured active elapsed time when complete, otherwise documented conservative elapsed-wall debit; NULL is never zero. Unresolved started operations remain charged/reserved. No rename, trigger, new batch or date-boundary resume resets consumed resources.
clock_accounting: Record each processing interval with real start/end, including tool wait; explicit maintenance/user-idle intervals may be excluded only with receipts. Unknown interruption retains remaining reservation pending reconciliation.
receipts: discovery/<local-day>/continuous-NNN-v1.started.json, .events.jsonl and .json; immutable terminal, exclusive starter; one unfinished discovery at a time across days.
deduplication: Use mechanism plus falsifiable question plus source/time scope as identity. Reuse read source content and rejected-family lessons. Do not reopen unchanged questions merely with synonyms or a new date; rotate to a distinct unexplored question. Retry a failed source only after the stated prerequisite changes.
priority: Required capture and timely intent; due confirmation; already prepared exploration; bounded discovery. Do not let discovery delay ready computation or final delivery.
no_hypothesis: NO_DEFENSIBLE_HYPOTHESIS is a conclusion for the completed batch, not a next-day time gate. The next heartbeat may inspect a different frontier immediately when resources and maintenance allow.
budget_recheck: When an actual local-day resource cap is exhausted, recheck at next local midnight or after reconciliation releases an unused reservation. No 09:00 gate.
